marketing.headline: Everything your team needs, on one screen.

security.title: Security
security.changePasswordDescription: Changing it signs out every other device.
security.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
security.twoFactorDescription: A code from your authenticator app on top of your password.
security.twoFactorOff: Your account is protected by a password alone.
security.disableConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication? Your password will be the only thing protecting the account.
security.regenerateConfirm: New codes replace the old ones. Any code you saved before stops working.

security.backupCodes: Store these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works once.

setup.introDescription: Add a second step to signing in.
setup.scanDescription: Scan the code, then type what your app shows.
setup.codesDescription: Two-factor authentication is on. These codes are your way back in.
setup.what: An authenticator app generates a new six-digit code every 30 seconds. Signing in asks for it alongside your password.
setup.step1: Install an authenticator app if you do not have one.
setup.step2: Scan the QR code with it.
setup.step3: Type the code it shows to finish.
setup.manualEntry: Or enter this key by hand

security.deleteDescription: Removes your account and everything attached to it.
